scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "cd backend && npm start" "cd frontend && npm start"
scripts.db:migrate: set PGCLIENTENCODING=UTF8 && psql -U postgres -d kiosque -f backend/src/db/schema.sql
scripts.db:schema: set PGCLIENTENCODING=UTF8 && psql -U postgres -d kiosque -f backend/src/db/schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: set PGCLIENTENCODING=UTF8 && psql -U postgres -d kiosque -f backend/src/db/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed-triage: set PGCLIENTENCODING=UTF8 && psql -U postgres -d kiosque -f backend/src/db/seed-triage.sql
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:schema && npm run db:seed && npm run db:seed-triage
